bias.en: Uptrend, momentum fading · SAR flipped bearish
bias.zh: 上升趋势、动能减弱 · SAR 翻空

read.en: Palantir slipped 0.2% on Oct 15 to $200.50 after trading as low as $192.60. It is below its 5-day average ($205.6) and above the 10-day ($199.1), 30-day ($186.3), 100-day ($156.7) and 200-day ($152.6), all rising. MACD has been above its signal since Oct 6 and is above zero, but the histogram is fading toward a cross, Parabolic SAR flipped bearish on Oct 15 ($212.9), and RSI is 63.
read.zh: Palantir 10月15日微跌 0.2%，收于 $200.50，盘中最低下探 $192.60。股价位于 5 日均线（$205.6）下方，并在均上行的 10 日（$199.1）、30 日（$186.3）、100 日（$156.7）和 200 日均线（$152.6）上方。MACD 自 10月6日起位于信号线上方并在零轴之上，但柱状图收窄、趋近交叉，抛物线 SAR 于 10月15日翻空（$212.9），RSI 为 63。

read.en: The intraday drop broke the last read's $196.5 SAR level, flipping it bearish; the close held the 10-day. Resistance is $204.4–205.6 (Oct 8 high, 5-day average), then $213 (Oct 12 record and SAR) and $220. Support is $199.1 (10-day), then $192.6–194.7 (Oct 15 low, Sep 24 high) and $186.3 (30-day). A close above $213 would be a new record; one below $192.6 would open $186.
read.zh: 盘中下跌击穿上次分析中的 $196.5 SAR 位置，SAR 随之翻空，但收盘守住 10 日均线。阻力为 $204.4–205.6（10月8日高点、5 日均线），其次 $213（10月12日纪录高点及 SAR）和 $220。支撑为 $199.1（10 日均线），其次 $192.6–194.7（10月15日低点、9月24日高点）和 $186.3（30 日均线）。若收盘站上 $213，将创纪录新高；若收盘跌破 $192.6，将打开至 $186 的空间。
